entries.reason: an enumeration has no symbol: the type and its cases are declared by the SDK's MLMultiArray.h and nothing in this port exports a name for them, in Apple's build or in ours, so there is nothing a build could point at. Measured, the shape is the same one the Metal family hit twice and the same answer came back here: tools/cache-index/first-rung.py answers NONE for MLMultiArrayDataType over every held cache, because there is no symbol to find
entries.source: SDK 16.4, MLMultiArray.h:18-23, the enumerator as the SDK writes it: the value is Apple's own, inlined into the consumer's code at compile time, and no release's Core ML carries a different one
entries.effect: the value is the SDK's own constant, inlined into the caller's code at compile time: 0x10000 | 64 is written in the port's copy of MLMultiArray.h and nothing here computes it
